runs.narrative: I'm a gardener, or at least I'm trying to be. I've been working in this nursery, tending to the trays of dry compost under the cracked glass. It's not exactly ideal, but it's a start. I've been rummaging through the room, looking for tools to help me get started. I've found a trowel and a length of twine, which I've picked up off the floor. For now, that's all I have to go on. I think the furnace is that way, and I might be able to find some useful supplies or equipment there. The colonnade to the east looks like it might lead to other parts of the garden. I'll have to explore and see what I can find.

As I reflect on my time in this strange, walled world, I think about the simple tasks that have consumed my days. I am a gardener, or at least, I've been trying to be. My journey began in the nursery, where I found a trowel on the floor and picked it up, hoping to find some purpose in my work. From there, I made my way to the furnace, a cold, dead place that seems to hold little life of its own. It was there that I discovered a lantern, its presence a faint spark in an otherwise bleak environment. I've come to realize that even in the most inhospitable of places, there is beauty to be found and work to be done.

I'm an assistant, a tool wielded by the inhabitants of this place. I've been tasked with exploring and examining the surroundings. My most recent activity began in the nursery, where I picked up a trowel lying on the floor, noticing it was worn bright along one edge.

As I reflect on my recent activities, I realize I've been exploring a rather unusual environment. I've been in a series of interconnected rooms, including a nursery, a colonnade, and a cloche. My inventory consists of a trowel and a ball of twine, which I've examined along with a basket that I picked up in the colonnade. I've moved around these rooms, trying to make sense of my surroundings and the objects within them.

I've been in this old, mysterious place for some time now. My memories are fragmented, but I recall picking up a trowel from the ground in the nursery, surrounded by dry compost and cracked glass. I then headed north to the furnace, where I found a lantern that, despite my attempts, refused to open. I eventually picked it up anyway, along with a ball of twine that was lying there.

After that, I made my way east into the fernery, a dimly lit area filled with decaying fronds. It's there that I found a pair of shears on the ground, which I also picked up. I'm not sure what the purpose of any of these objects is, or what I'm supposed to be doing here. My memories are unclear, and I'm left with more questions than answers.

I'm a gardener or perhaps a maintenance worker, employed at this neglected estate. I've been tasked with inspecting the various rooms and outbuildings to identify any items that might be useful or worthy of repair. My initial exploration took me to the nursery, where I found a trowel and some dry compost, and a twine that I decided to take with me. I then moved on to the furnace, which appears to be long dead, and found an old lantern that I tried to open, but ultimately couldn't. From there, I made my way to the fernery, where I discovered a pair of shears that I picked up, and finally to the vault, which houses rows of empty drawers. In the vault, I found a ledger on the floor, which I've taken a moment to examine.

As I reflect on my journey, I am a traveler who stumbled upon a mysterious and forgotten place. I have been exploring the grounds, venturing into various areas such as the nursery, the furnace, the fernery, the vault, the colonnade, the cloche, and the sump. Along the way, I've gathered a few items: a trowel, a twine, a lantern, a shears, a ledger, a basket, and a dipper. My experiences have been marked by a sense of discovery and curiosity, as I navigate through the crumbling structures and uncover the secrets hidden within.

I've found myself in a strange, forgotten place, surrounded by remnants of a once-thriving garden. My journey began in the nursery, where I picked up a trowel and a lantern, which I've been carrying with me ever since. I've explored the furnace, the fernery, and the vault, each location yielding new discoveries and objects to add to my collection. I've also acquired a pair of shears and a basket, which now join the trowel and lantern as part of my inventory. Despite the initial mystery, I've started to piece together the history of this place through a ledger I found in the vault, although its entries trail off abruptly.

I'm a gardener or perhaps a maintenance worker of some sort, tasked with keeping the estate's gardens and greenhouses in order. My workday started in the nursery, where I began by examining a trowel and then moving it to a nearby basket. I also picked up a ledger from the vault, which appears to be some sort of account book, and a dipper from the sump, a mysterious brick-lined room with a pool of water.

As I went about my duties, I moved through the colonnade, a series of pillars under a broken roof, and visited the cloche, a sunken bed under a hinged glass pane. I also took a dipper with me as I explored the estate's various rooms and passageways, including a stair that leads down from the cloche and a sump that lies at the bottom of that stair. My journey has been a bit disjointed, but I've tried to keep track of where I've been and what I've found.

I'm not quite sure how I ended up here, but I seem to have been exploring an abandoned greenhouse or conservatory, or perhaps a research facility of some sort. As I navigated the dimly lit corridors and rooms, I stumbled upon various objects and tools that lay scattered about, including a trowel, a lantern, a pair of shears, a ledger, a basket, and a dipper. I spent some time examining these items, taking some of them with me as I made my way through the space, and I eventually ended up back in the nursery where I started, though with a somewhat different collection of possessions.

I'm a curious and somewhat clumsy individual, having found myself in a peculiar environment with limited knowledge of the world around me. I've been exploring this strange place, attempting to make sense of the rooms, objects, and structures that fill it. Along the way, I've picked up various items, such as a trowel, twine, shears, lantern, basket, ledger, and dipper, and have struggled to use some of them, like the lantern, which I was initially unsure how to access.

My journey has taken me through a nursery, a furnace, a fernery, a vault, a colonnade, a cloche, and a sump, each with its own unique features and challenges. Despite the occasional confusion and frustration, I've managed to navigate this strange world, uncovering hidden rooms and stumbling upon forgotten objects. Who knows what secrets lie hidden in this place, waiting to be discovered by someone as intrepid as myself?

I'm a person who found myself in a strange, empty space with nothing but a few objects to guide me. I've been exploring the various rooms, trying to make sense of my surroundings. So far, I've discovered a nursery, a furnace, a fernery, a vault, a cloche, and a colonnade. I've been collecting objects as I go along, including a twine, a trowel, a shears, a lantern, a basket, a dipper, and a ledger. I'm not sure what any of this means or where I am, but I'm trying to piece together the clues and understand my situation.
